notes.title: Patch v1.11
notes.notes:
This is a stability patch providing numerous fixes, including:


 Inventory Quantity and Power Quantity Stacking Glitch that may have meant the amount of items in your inventory was out of sync with your Power Bar Quantity.
 Energy Well may have been glitched for some and could not be picked up off the ground when it drops.
 Corrected a couple of grammatical issues with some of the quest screens.

notes.title: Patch v1.07 out now!
notes.notes:
Patch v1.07 adds the following features and changes:


 Added a Statistics button to the Achievements screen to allow you to see additional metrics that were previously hidden.
 Iridium armor is now visible as a crafting item when you go above level 7, previously it hid but as you need Iridium to make Stone armor it makes no sense for that to continue.
 Crafted (i.e. the number of times you crafted an item) is now recorded as a metric.
 Clicking on your Birthstone or Cataclysm on the Character screen will now repeat the text you saw when you were assigned that item.
 Birthstone powers now kick in more frequently.
 Completely redesigned the lighting system, lighting should now be a lot prettier.
 ESC key now triggers the game menu as well as the ~ key.
 Fixed and issue where the Change Log and Options menu items from the in-game menu may not have been selectable from keyboard or controller.
 Window Transparency setting in options has been replaced with Glow Effect, this option allows you to minimize the complexity of the glow bubbles for lighting. Setting it to reduced will improve performance.
 Added level 8+ combat power called Meteor.
 When a controller is in use (or on SteamDeck) the circle buttons will show the tooltip text on the button, it`s dawned on me that tooltip text will never show up when using a controller and some of those buttons were vague one word or even a symbol before, so the tooltip text was important.

notes.title: Lots of changes added to v1.01
notes.notes:
Here's just part of the changes made to this version, ahead of the launch on June 26th.


 Tab key now toggles Story mode on and off. Much more than hiding the HUD, this feature also hides tool tips and a few other things so you can play with all the clutter off. You can also take great screenshots and videos this way.
 Fixed a bug with the loading screen that meant if you resized the window using F11 the position of the loading elements may have been incorrect.
 Improvements have been made to the Cursedlands Map.
 Fixed a bug with the Family Stone effect, causing active map filters to drop off.
 Added a short tip area to the load screen. Each time you load the game you'll cycle through the available tips, until it runs out and starts over.
 Tweaked some of the Crypts content.
 Footprints in the snow was added in this patch. You can turn this feature off in Options.
 R key now opens a Quick Use screen, allowing you to use any of your usable items in your inventory.
 New visual effect when gaining or losing bounty and when gaining or losing coins.
 Hiring an NPC now correctly closes the NPC window.
 Added a flying hint tip to Elder Forest.
 Some NPCs now have little blurbs of text to say as you walk past.
 Speech bubbles now activate with a lighting effect to make them easier to read in the dark.
 Monsters 2 levels lower than your own level will now reset to neutral status and not attack you. Your combat pet will not be able to start a fight with these by default, so you'd have to land the first blow.

notes.title: v0.98 Update Released
notes.notes:
v0.98 has been released.

Better controller support, if on the main game menu and a controller is plugged in the game menu will automatically adapt to show the change in keys.

Ready button no longer shows up in Inventory popup if you have all your power slots full. Instead use P screen or Inventory screen to unready an item.

Powers screen now shows blank slots for unused power slots allowing you to equip a power right out of the power window.

Item information popups have been modified to use the new button interface with the  buttons on keyboard triggering the left and right action, same goes for Controller support.

Many more popups now visibly show the X button or A button (Controller) to indicate which button closes the popup.

Added icons on top of the power buttons, previously this was text. Icons are easier to convey the action associated with that power.

Quest Journal buttons have been corrected, you will need to return to the NPC or spot you got the quest from to complete it, the buttons to turn in should not have been showing up on the Quest Journal screen. Oops!.

Clicking a quest on the quest tracker list below your avatar (top left), will now jump to the Quest Journal for that quest instead of asking you if you wish to cancel tracking.

Fixed a rare bug to do with quests and tracking that may have inadvertently caused corruption in some soul data, leading to NPCs randomly breaking and the game loop failing.

notes.title: v0.95 Bug Fixes and New Things!
notes.notes:
The following changes were added as part of v0.95.


 Added some new environmental effects such as flies, flames, flowers, stars, tornados etc.... these should add a little more ambience to some maps.
 Fixed a bug introduced in the last build concerning looting some items off the ground causing an error.
 Fixed a memory leak error caused by assets not de-initializing from the previous map when changing maps.
 Added the feather potion which allows you to change the color of your feathers. See Storekeep at Frontiersville.
 Queen Stinger and Necromancer now have new combat abilities.
 Fixed an issue with some quest line buttons not matching up with the on-screen text, this was introduced a few patches ago unfortunately.

notes.title: Patch 0.89 is out now!
notes.notes:
Patch v0.89 has been released with the following changes.


 New NPC Quest Screens
 Fixed an issue with some game windows throwing an error when you use F11 to resize your game window with said in-game screens open.
 The main screen now correctly shows the last character you played, versus the last character you made.
 Completing Lady J`s starting quests now removes the icon above the Exit (previously it would only disappear if you exited and entered the Inn again).
 Fixed an issue with Save and Exit potentially exiting during the save causing the save file to be deleted.
 Added a new in-game feature to restore a save file backup. This can be accessed via the main menu, Options screen then the Backup(s) button. Restoring a save will overwrite your current corresponding character with it's earlier incarnation.
 Added a browse button to the Options screen when not logged in, clicking this will open Windows Explorer and navigate to the game install folder.

notes.title: v0.87 Cosmetic and Gameplay Changes
notes.notes:
The following changes have been applied to v0.87.


 A change to the way monster damage is displayed on screen has been added. Damage totals are now grouped together when you use a power, so you know exactly what kind of damage your powers put out.
 The Map (M) screen now shows you a running total of how many maps you have unlocked.
 Combat damage/effect messages now display above the lighting layer so they can be read easily day or night
 Ability range circle now draws above the lighting layer so you can see it more easily.
 Fixed an issue with spells not auto-targeting a monster if nothing was selected and the monster did not bump into you.
 New commands, the  key attempts to select and move to the nearest monster to the right.

notes.title: v0.83 Performance Update and Fixes
notes.notes:
A larger update than most, this contains a number of patches and bug fixes.


 Holding down Shift key while taking a screenshot with F7 / F8 will disable darkness allowing for a much brighter image. Not holding down Shift will use the current lighting.
 F7 and F8 now work during the loading screen and main menus without having a character loaded. Enabling you to capture more of the game for whatever reason.
 Changed cleanup code for monster and map object clean up when exiting a map. In particular to resolve boulder traps not being properly destroyed.
 The Hair Dye item now presents a screen allowing you to pick a new hair color. There are more selections available than the Character Creation screen.
 The Storekeep at Frontiersville now also sells Skin Cream and an Eye Potion to allow you to change skin and eye coloring post character creation.
 Using TAB to turn HUD off now sticks and remains off if you change maps. Previously it may have turned back on.
 Various performance tweaks and changes to improve FPS in certain areas.
 New /commands /cpu and /gpu (default) switch between CPU and GPU rendering. Useful if GPU rendering is not running as fast as possible.
 Health and Energy regeneration no longer has a heart or pot fly from your character, there is now a more subtle animation

notes.title: v0.81 Changes and Updates
notes.notes:
The following changes and fixes have been applied in patch v0.81.


 Fixed a bug that caused an error if your combat pet tried to take your damage BUT a trap was the one dealing the damage.
 Auto-skip intro added if you have a character already when you are making a new character.
 Added Shard spell to the Crafting station at Sanctum.
 Crafting recipe mouse over at the Crafting station now shows how many items you have.
 Added Greater Ring of Diving to the Crafting station at Sanctum.
 Fixed an issue with Pilfering that may have caused you to be unstealthed when you got money.
 Fixed an issue with stealth energy loss turning off when you change maps.

notes.title: Patch 0.77 with Pilfering Added
notes.notes:
Today sees the implementation of patch 0.77 which includes the new Pilfering ability.

What is Pilfering?
Good Question, it is the art of stealing from an NPC. Please note PILFERING raises your bounty, so is only intended for folks that like to embrace being naughty/criminal.

How to Pilfer?
Stealth, stand next to an NPC, click/select the NPC and click SPACE.

You'll receive either a random item, some money or a chest (rare chance). If you fail you may be unstealthed.

Also added to this patch:


 Some interface sound effects now play at 30% of your Effect volume level.
 Added Timid Tim and the Back Alley Club to the Alley behind Frontiersville.
 Added a fix to prevent the secondary pet from not loading correctly due to a scaling issue.
 The Quest Journal now groups Complete and Incomplete quests together, with Incomplete quests shown first. This makes it easier to find a quest you are working on.

notes.title: v0.76 Sound Effects Patch 2
notes.notes:
The second patch containing updates  to over twenty monster sound effects.

This patch will also become the new DEMO version.

notes.title: v0.75 Sound Effect Improvement Patch Part 1
notes.notes:
Todays patch includes a number of improvements to the way sounds work in game. In particular regard to NPCs and interacting with NPCs.

A number of the NPCS were previously scripted with a generic series of sound effects which gets repetitive. Work is ongoing to update these to be a little more enjoyable.

A number of monsters have also had new sound effects added as all too often I simply went with "Bear" attack noises .... lazy but this is why the game is currently going through early access to iron out these last few kinks.

Speaking of kinks, a glitch which caused male players to use the female voice has been fixed.

Please note this is simply Part 1 of a series of patches to correct the sound effects.

notes.title: Pre-release Stable Build 0.68 Released
notes.notes:
Throughout the past year we've been working in the background patching our development version, adding new features and generally working towards today.

With the release of version 0.68 we believe the game is sufficiently far along to warrant pre-release.

We've packed in some more excellent features these past few weeks including keyboard key mapping and bindable macros to allow players to really customize how they play Banished Stone.

Check out the patch notes thread in the discussion group for a full list of what's changed!

Banished Stone has been a labor of love, and as an indie developer it's great to finally give more people a chance to play!

See you in the Ridge!

notes.title: Pre-Release Build Now Available
notes.notes:
We are super proud to announce the pre-release build of Banished Stone has now been made live on Steam.

We recognize purchasing a pre-release game is a question mark for some folks, but promise you that as of right now there are over ten hours of content available for playing in the current build.

It contains nearly all the core features we expect to have available for the full release (tentatively scheduled in July) and the only thing missing is some additional content and any bug fixes that need to be made as issues come to light during pre-release.

We hope you give Banished Stone a chance, and remember if you're not interested in the pre-release but still curious you can try the DEMO version we released just note it's a slightly earlier build and has a little less content.

May the denizens of the Ridge be kind to you as you traverse the game!
